Container.Name: musicarr
Container.Overview: Self-hosted music library manager. Point it at Deezer, Tidal, or Qobuz, follow the artists you care about, and it keeps your library filled in automatically using MusicBrainz as the release catalog. Optional torrent/Usenet indexer support, optional multi-user listening room at /player. Single container, single SQLite-backed process.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: music library manager deezer tidal qobuz musicbrainz downloader
Container.Requires: Internet access for streaming-provider logins and MusicBrainz lookups. A Deezer, Tidal, or Qobuz account (or a torrent/Usenet indexer) to actually download anything.
